content.title: MyPaymentsTracker
content.intro: A simple web app that lets you log, categorize, and visualize personal payments so you always know where your money goes.

sections.title: Log payments fast
sections.body: Add transactions in seconds with auto‑complete categories and date pickers.

sections.title: See spending trends
sections.body: Dynamic charts show where you spend most each month, week, or year.

sections.title: Stay on budget
sections.body: Set budget limits and get alerts when you approach them.

cta.label: Try it now
cta.note: Free signup, no credit card required
